question: Is the ball tracked after the kick on the shots the spotter misses? (owner, 2026-10-27)
status: descriptive, CPU, written before any measure
shots: the 269 labelled shots of shots_learn/v3/missed.parquet (hit or missed by the v3 spotter on the no-grass tracks), M1 left out (its camera)
window: the 1.5 s after the labelled shot, the players' (even) frames

measures.flight tracked: the linked ball gets 5 m or more from the shooter (truth position at the label) within the window
measures.toward the goal: the linked ball gets 3 m or more closer to the nearer goal line than the shooter
measures.candidates toward the goal: frames with a kept v3 candidate (any confidence) whose ground point is 3 m or more closer to that goal line than the shooter
